dcterms:description: The Kinetics Human Action Video Dataset consists of 400 different human activity classes with 10 seconds of videos covering a broad range of movements, such as sports, basic body motions, eating or cooking related activities, hobbies, and communicative motions.
dcterms:title: Kinetics Human Action Video Dataset

dcterms:description: The IAPR TC-12 dataset consists of 200K images and their captions, used for testing the model's performance on static inputs.
